attributes.name: Impervious Fortress Plate
attributes.powers:
If proficient with heavy armors, reveal this card to add 1d8 to you Constitution non-combat check.

Discard this card to reduce all damage dealt to you to 0; if proficient with heavy armors, you may recharge this card instead. 

If proficient with heavy armors, you may recharge this card when you reset your hand.
